description: Says who a marketplace relay address really is: attaches every email the relay contact brought to the real client's conversation and moves the relay address onto that client, as the relay thread's Link to a contact does. relayClientId is the relay contact, clientId the real client (read clients). Writes a routing correction to the activity log. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying; a repeat returns the first result.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: attach_relay_contact
title: Attach a relay contact's emails to a client
